title: Stat tile
summary: A headline number with a label, an optional change indicator (arrow, sign and a spoken form), a sparkline and a tone. With an href the whole tile is one link. The tile prop gives the compact dashboard look; interactive makes a tile with no href a button.

props.name: delta
props.description: Percent change, for example 12.5 or -3; shows an arrow and a signed percentage.

props.name: deltaDirection
props.description: Override the direction derived from delta.

props.name: invert
props.description: Down is good news (costs, returns): swaps the trend colours.

props.name: versus
props.description: What the change compares with, spoken to assistive technology.

props.name: values
props.description: Points for the sparkline (needs at least two).

props.name: tile
props.description: The compact dashboard tile look: less padding, a 600-weight larger value, a panel background.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Without an href, make the tile a button (Enter and Space) that fires pk-activate.

events.name: pk-activate
events.description: The tile link was pressed. Cancel to stop navigation (a Blazor OnClick handler navigates itself).

a11y: The change is text (an arrow glyph and a sign) and has a spoken form ("up 12.5 percent versus last month"), so colour is never the only signal. A tile with href holds one link named by the label and value, so there is a single tab stop. An interactive tile is a role=button overlay reachable by keyboard.

examples.title: Tones
examples.html:
<pk-stat label="Open POs" value="12"></pk-stat>
<pk-stat label="Negative on hand" value="3" tone="critical" href="#"></pk-stat>

examples.title: Change and trend
examples.html:
<pk-stat label="Sales, September" value="$18,420" delta="12.5" versus="last month" values='[12,15,14,17,18]'></pk-stat>
<pk-stat label="Return rate" value="2.1%" delta="-0.4" invert></pk-stat>
